wb_len_viirs_monthly.notes: Cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs read as remote WINDOWS: each record hashes the exact window bytes read (sha256_window), with the file's ETag/Last-Modified, not the whole 3-4 GB file. Only 'ops' processing (2017-04 onward) is used: earlier 'rp2' months have a different background level. The composites/ folder is not described in the README; licence from the AWS registry entry (verified 2026-10-05).
wb_len_viirs_monthly.provider: World Bank / University of Michigan (Light Every Night, AWS Open Data), composites of NOAA VIIRS DNB data in the EOG monthly format
wb_len_viirs_monthly.type: Monthly average radiance (avg_rade9, nW/cm2/sr) + cloud-free night count (n_cf), stray-light corrected (ecm-slcorr)
